observations: Photo 0: A dusty metallic automatic transmission/gearbox assembly with starter motor attached, mounting bolts, and a loose wiring connector hanging free.
Photo 1: Close-up of the same unit showing the starter motor, an unplugged multi-wire connector, and a solenoid/sensor housing; no manufacturer plate or part number visible.
Photo 2: Side/rear view of the gearbox showing the bell-housing, torque converter face, and a flywheel-like flexplate pattern; surface is covered in grime and oil residue.
A watermark 'GOD OF ABRAHAM INVESTMENT' overlays all images; no VIN tag, part sticker, or brand logo is legible in any shot.
No vehicle, engine bay, or dashboard shown to confirm which car model the gearbox fits.

claims.claim: Dealer in all kinds of Japanese parts and gearbox
claims.evidence: No brand, part tag, or VIN visible in photos 0-2 to confirm Japanese origin or specific make.
No bench test, fluid check, or shaft rotation shown in any photo.

risks.risk: Internal gear/clutch wear or damage not visible from outside
risks.proof: A video of the input/output shaft being rotated by hand or a bench test clip

risks.risk: Unknown vehicle compatibility (make, model, engine code)
risks.proof: A clear photo of the part/model number tag or a photo of the donor vehicle's VIN plate
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unidentified gearbox, lowest comparable bracket

risks.proof: Photo of drained transmission fluid or dipstick showing fluid color/level

risks.risk: Mileage/age of donor vehicle unknown, affecting wear estimate
risks.proof: Odometer photo or service record from donor vehicle

risks.risk: Missing or damaged internal solenoids/sensors (loose wire seen in photo 1)
risks.proof: Close-up of the connector fully seated and a continuity/resistance test reading

proof_requests: Clear photo of the part number/model tag or stamped casting number on the gearbox casing
Video of the shaft being manually rotated or a bench spin test
Photo of the donor vehicle's VIN plate or the gearbox's install location for make/model confirmation
Photo of transmission fluid color and level
Close-up of the unplugged wiring connector fully seated, confirming no damage
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a used automatic gearbox/transmission assembly, but with no brand, model, or compatibility markings legible and no functional test shown, it must be priced at worst case as an unverified, untested used unit of unknown fitment.
